scores.claim_text: As of December 31, 2024, SailPoint had 79 issued patents and 15 patent applications pending in the United States relating to its identity-security technology.
scores.M_value: n_total_applications=101, n_granted=73 pre-cutoff; 86 of 101 applications categorized 'identity' (access/credential/authentication/governance/IGA). Assignee 'SailPoint Technologies, Inc.'
scores.interpretation: USPTO ODP independently corroborates the patent claim. 73 granted pre-cutoff (ODP indexes applications and counts the granted subset; consistent with the filing's '79 issued' within timing/rounding), with the overwhelming majority of titles squarely in the claimed identity-management / IGA / access-governance technology area. No Nikola-pattern gap (large claim, ~0 in claimed area). Strong PASS.

scores.claim_text: SailPoint's solutions are deeply integrated with enterprise platforms including Microsoft, SAP, Workday, and ServiceNow.
scores.M_value: megacap namecheck returned 0 Microsoft hits (signal INFLATION_SUSPECT, but query only executed against Microsoft); direct EDGAR FTS of Microsoft and Visa filings each returned 0 mentions of 'SailPoint'.
scores.interpretation: Product-integration partnerships (identity connectors into Microsoft/SAP/Workday/ServiceNow) are not material counterparty obligations and are virtually never separately disclosed by the platform vendor in its SEC filings (calibration heuristics 5 and 8). The INFLATION_SUSPECT signal is a false positive here: the subset call only checked Microsoft, and these are technical integrations, not customer-concentration relationships a counterparty would name. No registry covers integration-partnership claims for a SaaS vendor. UNVERIFIABLE (honest), NOT severe.

scores.claim_text: SailPoint counts half of the Fortune 500 and 25% of the Forbes Global 2000 as customers.
scores.M_value: 129 total SailPoint mentions across SEC filers (10-K/etc.). The corpus confirms broad enterprise referencing of SailPoint as a vendor/IT-security provider, but the bulk of hits are SailPoint's own pre-take-private public-co filings; the specific 50%/25% penetration figures are not independently quantifiable in any registry.
scores.interpretation: Independent SEC full-text evidence confirms SailPoint is a real, widely-referenced enterprise vendor (consistent with deep large-enterprise penetration), so the directional claim is corroborated. But the precise 'half the Fortune 500 / 25% of Forbes Global 2000' figures cannot be verified against any registry and are self-reported marketing metrics. Scored MODERATE: real enterprise presence confirmed, exact magnitude unverifiable rather than contradicted.

scores.claim_text: As of October 31, 2024, SailPoint's ARR was $813.2 million (+30% YoY), with SaaS ARR of $485.7 million (+40% YoY).
scores.M_check: No federal/registry source covers SaaS ARR. (calibration heuristic 8)
scores.M_value: ARR / SaaS-ARR are non-GAAP operating metrics not recorded in any external registry; only the audited GAAP revenue ($621.5M for 9mo ended Oct 31 2024) is in the filing itself.
scores.interpretation: ARR and SaaS ARR are management-defined operating metrics with no independent registry hook. Per calibration heuristic 8 (SaaS ARR is not in any federal registry), these are honestly UNVERIFIABLE. The audited GAAP revenue trajectory in the financials is internally consistent with the ARR growth narrative, so there is no contradiction signal.

scores.claim_text: SailPoint's leadership in identity governance/security has been recognized by independent research firms including Gartner, Forrester, and KuppingerCole.
scores.M_check: No federal/public registry covers private analyst-firm (Gartner/Forrester/KuppingerCole) ratings.
scores.M_value: Analyst-firm Magic Quadrant / Wave / Leadership-Compass placements are proprietary research products, not recorded in EDGAR or any federal registry.
scores.interpretation: Third-party analyst recognition is a real category of evidence but lives behind private paywalls, not in any registry the framework can query. UNVERIFIABLE (honest). This is a standard, non-quantified credibility claim with no contradiction available.

scores.claim_text: In December 2024 SailPoint acquired the IGA business of Imprivata for $10.7M + up to $7.4M contingent, and previously acquired SecZetta.
scores.M_value: SecZetta appears in 6 third-party SEC filings (Synchrony Financial DEF 14As 2020-2022; Epiphany Technology Acquisition Corp 10-Ks/DEF 14A) confirming it is a real, independently-referenced identity/non-employee-risk vendor that SailPoint acquired. Imprivata is a known Thoma Bravo portfolio company; the acquisition is recent self-disclosure.
scores.interpretation: The acquired entities are real and independently corroborated in third-party SEC filings (SecZetta). The Imprivata IGA carve-out is a sister-portfolio Thoma Bravo transaction disclosed with specific consideration ($10.7M + up to $7.4M contingent) and is too recent (Dec 2024) for counterparty disclosure but is consistent and concrete. PASS on existence/coherence of the disclosed acquisitions.

scores.claim_text: SailPoint has built an ecosystem of over 1 million skilled professionals (SIs, VARs, MSSPs) that can implement its solutions globally.
scores.M_check: No registry covers a marketing 'ecosystem headcount' across independent SIs/VARs.
scores.M_value: An aggregated count of third-party-employed implementation professionals across the global SI/VAR/MSSP channel has no federal-registry or counterparty-disclosure hook.
scores.interpretation: A '1 million skilled professionals' ecosystem figure is an unauditable marketing aggregate spanning independent partner firms; no registry records it. UNVERIFIABLE (honest), not manufactured into severity.

scores.claim_text: SailPoint carries a $1.59 billion senior secured Term Loan (Thoma Bravo take-private leverage), 11.10% interest as of Oct 31 2024, reduced to ~$1.04 billion by Jan 15 2025 after a $550M equity-funded paydown.
scores.M_check: Prospectus self-disclosure only (going_concern_detector surfaced only a POST-cutoff 2026 10-K, which is firewalled and was NOT used).
scores.M_value: Prospectus: $1.59B Term Loan @ 11.10% (Oct 31 2024); $1.04B outstanding by Jan 15 2025; Thoma Bravo $600M equity used to repay $575M of debt; in compliance with all covenants; states existing cash + Credit Facility sufficient for >=12 months.
scores.interpretation: The heavily leveraged take-private balance sheet, the high 11.10% rate, and the equity-funded paydown are all fully and transparently disclosed and internally consistent. No registry covers this at the IPO date (the going-concern detector only returned a post-cutoff filing, which is firewalled). Honest, complete disclosure of a real risk = PASS on the framework's honesty axis; the leverage itself is a fundamental risk, not a masking signal.
